plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Music, Fine Arts, AA' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/fine-arts-music-aa/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Music Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog defines its plan footnotes on this page: 4 = 'See approved General Education list for the AA/AS Degree', 5 = 'See program recommendations and requirements. Students transferring to UNR should consult with an advisor', 6 = 'See approved Foreign Language list for the AA Degree' — unspecified slots are modeled as choice slots with those definitions in choice_note; see advisor. 14 units of foreign language are required for students transferring to UNR. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
